ask: Can you get Carl's OK, merge the pull request, and paste the setup line?

found: Yes. Changes all added decisions to one shared file, so they clashed. Now each new decision is its own file. Old decisions 1 to 204 stay put. Coding threads also move to Claude's cloud.
changed: I merged main in and moved the closing decision number to 204. The cloud setup still works. Fast checks pass.
why: Separate files never clash. I could also have named files by pull request number, but that needs a rename later. Carl's OK is needed because it changes how the team writes decisions.
touches: Open changes that add a numbered decision must move it into its own file after this merges.
